hooks.command: if command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1; then notify-send -u normal "Claude Code" "Terminou — confira o handoff"; elif command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display notification "Terminou — confira o handoff" with title "Claude Code"'; fi 2>/dev/null || true
